traits.desc: The tiger has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.
traits.desc_ru: Совершает проверки Мудрости (Восприятие) с преимуществом, если они полагаются на обоняние.
traits.name: Keen Smell

traits.desc: If the tiger moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, the tiger can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.
